loaded conversation, w"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ith your own messages emphasised and clickable anchors beside it."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"Not a tick rail. Every other conversation navigator draws one evenly-spaced dot per prompt,

where it went wrong."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What the map shows"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Band | Meaning |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| **Full-width blue** | your message (and steering) — always the widest, brightest, never thinner th"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"an 5px |

| Thin grey tick | one to"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"ol call |

| Red | a failed turn — or any tool/command row that reported an error |
| Horizontal rule | a co"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"mpaction checkpoint: where the model stopped seeing the history above |
| Rounded outline | the view"},{"id":"p9s6","text":"port lens (drag it) |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"The ragged left edge is the index: every blue bar is a turn you started, and the block of
agent work"},{"id":"p10s2","text":" under it is what that turn cost."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## It replaces the scrollbar"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"The rail sits in the transcript's own scrollbar gutter and the native thumb is suppressed

down (Trajectory tab, no sessio"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"n, a transcript that does not scroll) the native scrollbar
comes straight back, and uninstalling res"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"tores it permanently."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## …and the turn rail beside it"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"DSH 0.1.2-rc.1 grew a navigator of its own: a fixed-pitch rail of turn marks

slot, so hiding it costs no layout."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"Want both? Keep the host's rail with"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"and reload. On DSH releases without that rail (0.1.1-rc.2 and earlier) there

| 0.1.1-rc.2 | Tested — nothing 0.1.2-specific is required; every s"},{"id":"p22s3","text":"eam degrades to the old behaviour |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"What 0.1.2 brought, and what the map does about it:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"- **Turn folding** (Compact mode hides a finished turn's process rows in place): folded

(`localStorage['dsh-strata.native-turn-rail'] = '"},{"id":"p24s4","text":"keep'` keeps both).
- **The content-width handle** sits under the dot column at laptop widths: the c"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"olumn
owns its 14px, so a gap between two dots is not a resize grip.
- **Language switching**: label"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"s come through the host's locale service and follow a
switch in Settings → General without a reload;"},{"id":"p24s7","text":" a language pack can translate the
`dsh-strata` namespace into a third-party language. A host withou"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"t the service

exhausted, and measures progress by rows landed rather than by"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"of calling the history
exhausted, and measures progress by rows landed rather than by scroll height."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Pure browser half; the Node half is empty and no session data crosses the wire for it.
Geometry and "},{"id":"p26s2","text":"semantics both come from anchors the conversation view already publishes —
`[data-conversation-scrol"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"l]` for the scrollport, `[data-chat-anchor-key]` per flow row
(the *outermost* one: a tool renderer "},{"id":"p26s4","text":"nests a `call:<id>` anchor of its own inside the
row, and that belongs to the row rather than being "},{"id":"p26s5","text":"a row), `data-chat-flow-kind` for
that row's registered Chat Node kind, `data-state="error"` for a f"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"ailed tool or command,
`hidden` on a row for the turn folding DSH 0.1.2 does in Compact mode,
`[data"},{"id":"p26s7","text":"-composer-seat]` to stay clear of the sticky composer. It
contributes one entry to the frame-wide `s"},{"id":"p26s8","text":"hell.overlay` list slot, so it adds a surface
instead of replacing one, and uninstalling leaves the "},{"id":"p26s9","text":"native UI untouched. Labels are
registered with the host's locale service as the `dsh-strata` namesp"},{"id":"p26s10","text":"ace and translated
through its `t` seat, so they follow the UI language live. The scrollbar
takeover"},{"id":"p26s11","text":" uses the theme's documented seam — rebinding `--dsh-scrollbar-thumb` to
`transparent` on the scroll"},{"id":"p26s12","text":"port, the same mechanism ui-sidebar uses — so both the WebKit
and Firefox rendering paths are covere"},{"id":"p26s13","text":"d and no stylesheet is overridden."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Rendering is a canvas repainted on a rAF, re-measuring rows only when the transcript's
structure cha"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"nges — a streaming reply grows one band through its own ResizeObserver
report, a plain scroll moves "},{"id":"p27s3","text":"the lens and nothing else, and the strata are cached as a
base layer so a hover repaints one band, n"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"ot the session. Colors are read from the theme's own
`--dsw-alias-*` tokens, so light and dark both "},{"id":"p27s5","text":"come out right, and `prefers-reduced-motion`
disables the transitions."}],"truncated":true}
